references.text: The description of the Anakites and their origin, including Ahiman, Sheshai, and Talmai who lived in Hebron.
Israel's fear of the Anakites, who were tall and powerful, showing why their destruction was significant.
Refers to the Anakites as a great and tall people whom no one could stand against.
Caleb requests the Hebron area where the Anakites lived, and he drove them out from there.
Caleb took Hebron and drove out the three sons of the Anakites: Sheshai, Ahiman, and Talmai.
The capture of Debir, which is also mentioned in Joshua 11:21.
Parallel account of the conquest of Hebron and Debir after Joshua's death.
Hebron was given to Caleb, who drove out the three sons of the Anakites.
Goliath from Gath was one of the giants, possibly a descendant of the Anakites who survived in the Philistine cities.
